title: A time-series network approach to auditory verbal hallucinations: Examining dynamic interactions using experience sampling methodology
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-persons network
limitations: - Sample limited to individuals with severe AVHs; - Variables with different measurement levels not analyzed; - Fixed time interval assumption violated; - Group-level analysis may not capture individual differences; - Limited to continuous variables only.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. However, the authors mention that they report all R-code and model output in the Online Supplementary Materials, which suggests a level of transparency. The code and data are declared available in the supplementary materials.
